findings.finding: An equity line of up to $250m with SZOP Opportunities I LLC (dated 2025-10-24, resale registration effective 2026-07-31) is live. It prices each advance at the lower of the lowest traded price and the lowest hourly or daily VWAP in the pricing period, for up to $2.5m or 400% of median volume per accelerated advance. The issuer is a going concern with $1.37m cash at 30 June against an $11.1m Q2 net loss, and must hold $3.5m of stockholders' equity at the 2026-09-30 quarter end under its Nasdaq Panel Monitor, having had $5.18m at 30 June. So equity issuance is forced into exactly the 09-29 / 09-30 sessions, and it is priced at the session low.
findings.mechanism_in_window: The Q3 quarter end on 2026-09-30 is a hard date for the Panel Monitor's quarterly equity test. Equity sold after 09-30 does not count toward it, so draws, conversions or a discounted deal have to happen in the 09-29 and 09-30 sessions. The first of those sessions is the scored window. Because the equity line prices off the lowest trade, supply lands on the tape inside the window rather than overnight in a single print.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The same shape after the two earlier reverse splits, from the baseline's own comparable falls. 2025-09-02 fell -28.18% and the next close was -19.38%; the 10-Q dates the 1-for-9 split to September 2025, but not to this day. 2026-04-17 fell -20.28% and the next close was -2.96%, the month of the 1-for-8 split. After this split, 2026-09-25 fell -21.41% and the next close (today) was -22.84%. All 28 comparables: median -1.93%, up-rate 46.4%.
findings.why_not_priced: The close holds the dilution the tape has already seen. It does not hold the timing: a company that must show $3.5m of equity at 09-30 after an ~$11m quarterly loss has two sessions to add it, and a lowest-price facility sells into any intraday bounce. If the price held this, there would be no heavy-volume gap-and-extend today. There would also be an equity-line or 3.02 disclosure clearing the quarter's need, and there is none on EDGAR: full-text search for 'Equity Purchase Facility' from 2026-08-15 to 09-28 returns zero hits.
findings.independence: The 10-Q (a different document) carries the going-concern language, $1.37m cash and $5.18m equity: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1849820/000184982026000125/kitt-20260630.htm. The Panel Monitor's $3.5m-per-quarter condition through 2026-12-19 is in the 8-K of 2026-04-30: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1849820/000184982026000077/kitt-20260427.htm. Whether SZOP has actually drawn since 07-31 is NOT confirmed by any filing, and that is why the size is held small.

outside_window.finding: The $50m non-binding private-placement LOI of 2026-09-25 could become a definitive agreement; the quarter-end equity test gives the company a reason to sign by 09-30. It is undated, carries 'no assurance', and its sign is ambiguous: against a market cap of a few $m it implies change of control and very large issuance. Sized 0.

The Nasdaq Mandatory Panel Monitor ($3.5m stockholders' equity per fiscal quarter) runs to 2026-12-19. A Q3 failure would show in the 10-Q (Zacks cadence estimate 2026-11-13, not a company date) and would lead to a delisting determination without a new cure period.

Cumulative reverse splits of 9 x 8 x 6 = 432:1 within about 12 months. If the bid falls below $1 again, Nasdaq's rule for cumulative ratios of 250:1 or more over two years grants no compliance period. At $1.79 this is not yet live.

Senior secured convertible term loan with ATW, $16.36m gross at 30 June. Its conversion price has been cut by amendment four times (latest $1.80 pre-split, 2026-08-12), and a fifth amendment of 2026-09-17 extended maturity to 2028-01-31. Further reset-and-convert cycles are a recurring supply source with no date.
